This prevents j-loop parallelization because different iterations collide on the same memory location.

Use a temporary array `a_temp[j]` to store each j iteration's computed value independently. This eliminates the WAW collision:

This makes the j-loop a genuine Do-All loop—each j iteration accesses independent array elements and can run in parallel.
